verdict.rationale: An AI-training opt-out is a fair privacy-posture question for a financial-data platform like Mastercard Open Finance, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions AI-training data use, an opt-out, or a no-training commitment. The pack covers data APIs, webhooks, onboarding, testing and the MCP toolkit, none of which addresses this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
